a_before_b.rationale: The build-versus-buy decision is a broader strategic choice that encompasses cost and deployment trade-offs, but mastering the decision framework is not required to understand how to analyze specific financial and infrastructure trade-offs.

b_before_a.rationale: Understanding the financial and infrastructure trade-offs between proprietary APIs and self-hosting open-weight models provides the concrete cost and compute data needed to meaningfully evaluate whether to build or buy a foundation model.
